description: Set up Ruimte on this machine: how it works, the agent CLIs and computer use.

welcome.title: Welcome to Ruimte
welcome.bodyThree: Space for AI Engineering. Three short tasks get you started. Do them in any order, or come back to them later.
welcome.bodyTwo: Space for AI Engineering. Two short tasks get you started. Do them in any order, or come back to them later.

hub.title: Set up Ruimte
hub.closeNote: Close this any time. It stays under Settings › About.

providers.title: Connect providers
providers.header: Ruimte looked for agent CLIs on {{machine}}.

computer.title: Computer use
computer.header: Optional. Can be turned on later.

views.title: A project is a sidebar of views
views.body: Most views are a canvas where terminals, chats, browsers and files sit next to each other. A chat or a terminal can also stand alone as a view.

agents.title: Agents are the CLIs on your machine
agents.body: Claude Code, Codex and the others do the work. Each CLI keeps its own login, and sessions keep running when you close the window.

machines.title: Several accounts, several machines
machines.body: Add more than one account per CLI and pick one per chat. Put another machine on your account once and its projects open like local ones.

providers.info: Ruimte starts the agent CLIs installed on this machine. The CLI keeps the login and Ruimte only asks who is signed in. Logging in opens a terminal. You need one provider to start.
providers.none: Ruimte found no agent CLIs on this machine yet.
providers.notLoggedIn: Not logged in. Logging in opens a terminal.
providers.apple: Use the model on this Mac for chats and tools.
providers.missing_one: Install it, then restart Ruimte on this machine.
providers.missing_other: Install them, then restart Ruimte on this machine.
providers.doneWhen: Done once one provider is logged in

computer.info: Agents can see and operate the apps on a computer. They only reach an app after you allow it. The switch is per machine.

done.title: You're all set
done.reopen: Reopen this list from Settings › About.

summary.loggedInAndComputer_one: {{clis}} is logged in and computer use is on.
summary.loggedInAndComputer_other: {{clis}} are logged in and computer use is on.
summary.logInLater: {{clis}} can be logged in later under Settings › Providers.
summary.noProvider: Log in to an agent CLI under Settings › Providers before your first chat.
summary.computerLater: Computer use can be turned on later under Settings › Computer Use.
